meta.name: frame-liquid-bg-hero
meta.description: WebGL 风流体置换背景 + 顶部叠加金句, 适合视频片头 / landing hero / 海报

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成 WebGL 风流体背景与金句叠加动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在视频或网页中快速生成动态流体背景
copy.tagline_en: Generate WebGL fluid background with quote overlay animation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create dynamic fluid backgrounds for videos or web pages

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按你给的金句生成一份单文件 HTML 画面:流体感背景铺满画布,顶部叠加巨型金句,可带副标和 CTA chip。背景可选 CSS、canvas 或 WebGL 三种画法,打开浏览器即可看。
howto.when: 当你需要做视频片头帧、SaaS landing 顶部 hero 或海报底图时触发。它会先确定画布是横版还是竖版,再从 4 套调色里选一套。

say.text: 做一张流体背景片头帧,金句是「慢慢来,比较快」
换成 Aurora Violet 配色,画布改成 1080×1920 竖版
say.note: 极光紫流体 + 竖版画布

say.text: 背景改用 canvas 的 metaballs,文字放左下角
say.note: 中阶 canvas 画法,金句居左下

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns your quote into a single-file HTML hero: a fluid background fills the canvas, a large quote sits on top, with an optional subtitle and CTA chip. Background can be drawn with CSS, canvas, or WebGL.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a video intro frame, a SaaS landing hero, or a poster background. It asks for canvas orientation, then you pick one of four palettes.

say_en.text: Make a fluid-background intro frame, the quote is "Slow is smooth"
Switch to Aurora Violet and change the canvas to 1080×1920 portrait
Use canvas metaballs for the background and put the text bottom-left
say_en.note: Mid-tier canvas draw, quote at bottom-left
